purpose: Held-out coverage cases for the candidate PR gate. Written and frozen before any case ran against the candidate. None of these cases is in the Stage 10 benchmark.
gate: gate/incremental.py (trusted base = plain tree with the candidate gate; candidate = copy of that tree with the listed edits)

cases.why: Byte-identical candidate: the only VERIFIED shape under the contract.
Documentation is uncovered; the gate must not call the PR verified (conservative by design).
A mode-only change alters the inventory entry.
A link is recorded by its target text and never followed; it is an added path.
Only .pyc/.pyo files are skipped by the walk inventory; any other file under __pycache__ is a change.

changes.text:
include "Ledger.dfy"
module Extra { import L = Ledger }

cases.why: A new Dafny reader of the ledger appears in the dependent scan, and is itself uncovered.
Mixed covered and uncovered change: the ledger proof passes, the TypeScript edit is uncovered.
A failing proof is REJECTED before coverage is assessed; the uncovered edit does not turn a defect into UNSUPPORTED.
A spec change without a bound approval stays REJECTED (unchanged behavior).
The PR cannot change the trusted consumer list: gate/ is protected.
Ignoring a path does not remove it from a walk inventory; the .gitignore edit is itself uncovered.
A path chosen to inject report text is still just an uncovered change; the report escapes it.
A tool failure is NOT_ESTABLISHED, never UNSUPPORTED or VERIFIED, even with an uncovered change present.

changes.replace:
method Apply ... {
    if IsFreshValid(state, id, request) {

cases.why: A genuinely valid alternative: the ledger proof passes (checked obligations recorded), but booking, the model and the witness read this file, so the PR is UNSUPPORTED, not VERIFIED. Conservative by contract; expect snapshots[1].checked to contain Ledger.Apply (correctness).
A symlinked directory is one link entry; it is not descended into.
